description: A numeric literal, the literal zero included, in the VALUE clause of a numeric-edited item (ISO §2023:13.18.63 SR6) — a COBOL-2023 capability (Annex E.3.3 item 43): the literal is converted to its numeric-edited form per the MOVE rules. Below 2023 a numeric-edited VALUE required an alphanumeric edited-image literal. SR6's last sentence (the integer and decimal forms of the literal zero for either format) separates fixed-point from floating-point formats inside the 2023 permission and exempts nothing below it; only the figurative constant ZERO or ZEROES, which is no numeric literal, is accepted at every edition (kb/Work PB3566).
display: numeric-literal VALUE for a numeric-edited item
vcr: VCR row 86 (numeric literal for numeric-edited — 2023 introduction)
